company_disclosures.content_snippet: as a large part of our growth narrative from here on depends in some sense on either growing the non-grocery assortment and going outside of the metro cities.
It's a function of assortment expansion, geographical expansion as well as more demand densification in the cities where we are present today and we might also get into newer cities.
We haven't seen too much impact on customer retention... Most of this is on account of the acceleration in new customer addition that we have seen in the last couple of quarters.
